title: Stock Market Breakout: Smart Money Is Buying, You're Not!
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.view: Breadth indicators (S5FI ~18%, S&P/Nasdaq breadth ratio extreme) historically mark bottoms with the market higher ~30 days later.
Smart-money (institutional) and dumb-money (retail) flow are both turning up, rare and bullish; buyback blackout ending and earnings season should add participation.
Fundamentals (memory, storage, semis capex) are fantastic and expectations too low; AI spending won't stop even as models commoditize.
The Fed raises rates while expanding its balance sheet, so betting against the market means betting against the Fed.
Buying put walls and selling call walls worked for 3 months; breakouts with follow-through are returning, favoring swing trades.

calls.quote: every time we got to this 18% level and we get in here 30 days later, you're higher.
